meta_state_law_citations_007.answer: A teacher is considered tenured when meeting the requirements in Minnesota Statutes § 122A.41, or for those excluded from that statute, but are instead covered by Minnesota Statutes § 179A.03, subdivision 18(2) or Minnesota Statutes § 122A.26 (ECFE), when such teacher successfully completes the contractual Achievement of Tenure process (Article 5.5) if the teacher has also met the 120-days of teaching service requirement of the Tenure Act.
